notes: MANIFEST_TYPE=DOC treated as authoritative; heuristic classification skipped. Filename carries a date-numeric prefix (2026-08-03-) that superficially resembles an ADR numbering convention, and the doc lives under gsd/verifications/ - but content is verification evidence (method, findings, summary table, boundary), with no Context/Decision/Consequences structure and no status field, so DOC is consistent with the manifest. Findings reference prior finding IDs F1, F2, F3 by label only - no source doc path is given for them, so they are not resolvable cross_refs. Findings recorded: (1) no ServiceMonitor renders; (2) servicemonitor.yaml ranges over undefined .Values.microservices instead of .Values.services - root cause of #1; (3) all six app images resolve to 0.1.0-latest; (4) that violates the <semver>-<git-hash> brief and embeds literal 'latest'; (5) gateway is the only Ingress; (6) argocd-app.yaml has duplicate metadata.name so the Application is named cloudcart; (7) ingress.yaml has duplicate service.name so the backend points at non-existent Service sports-store-gateway - elevated from cosmetic to functional routing defect. Extra: frontend renders no workload; ESO restructure renders. Boundary: template render only, E2E not verified.
